hunks.baseline: Mages and warriors shared the same root—mana—but their trunks and branches stretched in entirely different directions.
hunks.sol: Mages and warriors shared the same root—mana—but their trunks and branches grew in entirely different directions.

hunks.baseline: That was why the Spellblade was considered just as impossible as the coexistence of mana and magical power. Perhaps even more so.
hunks.sol: That was why a Spellblade was considered as impossible as the coexistence of mana and magical power. Perhaps even more so.

hunks.baseline: In his youth, he had ranged across battlefields amid the turbulent politics of the Middle East, protecting his tribe. Then, as the Great Cataclysm began in his middle age, he awakened to a power he had never known existed.
hunks.sol: In his youth, he had crossed battlefields to protect his tribe amid the turmoil of the Middle East. Then, at the start of the Great Cataclysm, he had awakened a power he’d never known existed.

hunks.baseline: That was why he found this all the harder to believe.
hunks.sol: That made what he was seeing all the harder to believe.

hunks.baseline: Worse, the unit that had been holding back in the rear was made up of the elite troops he had personally trained. Swords and shields he had saved and saved for the most crucial moment.
hunks.sol: The unit waiting in the rear was made up of elite troops he had personally trained—swords and shields he had saved for the most crucial moment.

hunks.baseline: And now the arrows those very elites had loosed were stopped.
hunks.sol: Yet the arrows those very troops had loosed had been stopped.

hunks.baseline: No—they were under control.
hunks.sol: No. They had been seized.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of arrows, shot with ferocious force and brimming with mana, all at the wave of a hand.
hunks.sol: Dozens of arrows, shot with tremendous force and filled with mana, controlled by a single gesture.

hunks.baseline: The air stopped. The wind, thick with the stench of blood, disappeared.
hunks.sol: The air stopped. The wind, thick with the stench of blood, vanished.

hunks.baseline: In that space where everything had vanished like a desert mirage, the wave of steel pouring toward one man turned its head.
hunks.sol: In that space where everything else seemed to have disappeared like a desert mirage, the wave of steel pouring toward one man turned.

hunks.baseline: *Flick.*
hunks.sol: *Swish.*

hunks.baseline: Dozens of arrowheads, still brimming with mana, glinted in the darkness. They were pointed at the former masters who had sent them flying. And…
hunks.sol: Dozens of arrowheads glinted in the darkness, their mana still intact. They pointed toward the men who had shot them. And…

hunks.baseline: “Wow. It actually worked.”
hunks.sol: “Whoa. It worked?”

hunks.baseline: They were ready to obey the will of their new master.
hunks.sol: …awaited the will of their new master.

hunks.baseline: The old man stared at the young man’s face, smiling beneath a coating of blood, and clenched his teeth without meaning to.
hunks.sol: The old man stared at the young man smiling beneath a coating of blood and clenched his teeth without meaning to.

hunks.baseline: He wanted to ask, but the young man didn’t wait for the words of an old fool blinded by false faith.
hunks.sol: He wanted to ask, but the young man did not wait for an old fool blinded by false faith to find his words.

hunks.baseline: A fierce whistle of air shattered the silence. Hundreds of fanatics surrounding them watched the unbelievable sight with vacant eyes.
hunks.sol: The arrows’ fierce whistle shattered the silence. Hundreds of fanatics surrounding them watched in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: As if an invisible giant had drawn a bowstring, dozens of steel arrows came raining down—far faster and harder than before.
hunks.sol: As if an invisible giant had drawn a bowstring, dozens of steel arrows came raining down, faster and harder than before.

hunks.baseline: The old commander-in-chief who led and commanded every fanatic.
hunks.sol: The old commander-in-chief who led the fanatics.

hunks.baseline: A sword swung to knock the arrows aside shot into the air, along with its wielder’s arm.
hunks.sol: A sword swung to knock the arrows aside flew into the air, along with its wielder’s arm.

hunks.baseline: A scream erupted a moment later. Then came dozens of streaks of light, sweeping in and cutting through and smashing everything in their way.
hunks.sol: The scream came a moment later. Then dozens of streaks of light swept in, cutting through and smashing everything in their path.

hunks.baseline: The metallic taste of blood filled his mouth.
hunks.sol: The metallic taste of blood filled the old man’s mouth.

hunks.baseline: The old man bit down so hard that blood ran from his lips, but he didn’t even notice. He brought down the scimitar in his hand, unleashing a murky energy in which magical power and mana were mixed together.
hunks.sol: He had bitten his lip hard enough to draw blood without noticing. He brought down his scimitar, unleashing a murky force of mingled magical power and mana.

hunks.baseline: The immense pressure of wind that poured along the blade forced away the arrows flying in from the front.
hunks.sol: The immense wind pressure rushing off the blade pushed back the arrows flying in from the front.

hunks.baseline: Unlike Jin Taekyung, who had been surrounded and forced to face arrows coming from every direction, the old man had fanatics around him who would lay down their lives to stop the arrows for him.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung had been surrounded, forced to face arrows coming from every direction. The old man, by contrast, had fanatics around him willing to die to stop the arrows.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps that was why the old man had switched to the offensive at once and stepped forward. Why he trusted the dozens of followers surrounding him like shields.
hunks.sol: Perhaps that was why he stepped forward at once, turning to the offensive. Why he trusted the dozens of followers surrounding him like shields.

hunks.baseline: But the next moment, that faith vanished without a trace.
hunks.sol: The next moment, that trust vanished.

hunks.baseline: At the faint whistle of air, the old man’s eyes flew open.
hunks.sol: At the faint whistle of air, the old man’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: In his seasoned gray eyes, arrows were flying toward him as if alive, avoiding the fanatics.
hunks.sol: Arrows were flying toward him, weaving around the fanatics as though they were alive.

hunks.baseline: A cry like a scream rose to his tongue, then disappeared. No—he wasn’t even given time to let it out.
hunks.sol: A cry rose to his tongue, but he had no time to let it out.

hunks.baseline: The old man sucked in a breath and hurriedly swung his scimitar.
And as he watched the streaks of light fill the air around him, he knew by instinct:
hunks.sol: He sucked in a breath and swung his scimitar. As streaks of light filled the air around him, he knew.

hunks.baseline: Unlike Jin Taekyung, he couldn’t escape this attack.
hunks.sol: Unlike Jin Taekyung, he could not escape this attack.

hunks.baseline: The arrows caught in the scimitar’s path bent and broke.
hunks.sol: Arrows caught in the scimitar’s path bent and broke.

hunks.baseline: But even the old man, who had reached the superhuman realm, couldn’t deflect or dodge every last one.
hunks.sol: But even the old man, who had reached the superhuman realm, could not deflect or dodge them all.

hunks.baseline: Blood poured through his clenched teeth. His vision blurred for an instant, and he felt the pain pulsing through his body.
hunks.sol: Blood spilled through his clenched teeth. His vision blurred, and pain struck all through his body.

hunks.baseline: His ribs, legs, chest, back…
hunks.sol: Ribs. Legs. Chest. Back.

hunks.baseline: He felt the arrowheads pierce his armor and flesh, shatter bone. He also felt the hot energy packed into their tips seep into his insides.
hunks.sol: He felt arrowheads pierce armor and flesh and shatter bone. The heat they carried seeped deep into his organs.

hunks.baseline: His once-sturdy legs trembled. As the old man staggered, more than ten arrows buried deep in his body, the fanatics supporting him shouted like they were screaming in despair.
hunks.sol: His once-steady legs trembled. More than ten arrows buried deep in his body, he staggered into the arms of his followers.

hunks.baseline: The fanatics finally grasped what had happened, and they were more shaken than ever.
hunks.sol: The fanatics, finally grasping what had happened, were more shaken than ever.

hunks.baseline: If the Doppelganger, under the name of the Prophet, had been their spiritual pillar, the old man was the warrior chief favored by God, the general who led them.
hunks.sol: If the Doppelganger, calling itself the Prophet, was their spiritual pillar, the old man was the warrior chief favored by God—the general who led them.

hunks.baseline: Then a voice pierced their ears like a spike.
hunks.sol: A voice pierced their ears like a spike.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, heavy footsteps moved forward.
hunks.sol: Heavy footsteps advanced.

hunks.baseline: His voice was low and his face was etched with fatigue.
hunks.sol: The voice was low. The face above it was worn with fatigue.

hunks.baseline: But the fanatics who stepped back without realizing it neither saw nor felt any of that.
hunks.sol: But the fanatics stepping backward without realizing it saw none of that. In their wide eyes, there was only one thing:

hunks.baseline: Their eyes were wide, and they could see only one thing:
The flames flickering in his eyes.
hunks.sol: The flames flickering in his gaze.

hunks.baseline: His blood-crusted lips twitched. As Jin Taekyung smiled and reached out, an immense invisible force pressed down on the space around them.
hunks.sol: His blood-crusted lips twitched. Jin Taekyung smiled and reached out, and an immense, invisible force pressed down on the space around them.

hunks.baseline: A radius of dozens of meters already belonged to him. The hundreds of fanatics staring at him in shock were invaders. Demons defiling not only this land, but the entire world.
hunks.sol: Everything within a radius of dozens of meters already belonged to him. The hundreds of fanatics staring at him in shock were invaders. Demons defiling not just this land, but the entire world.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung looked down at the frozen fanatics with a gaze full of disgust.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung looked down at the frozen fanatics with disgust.

hunks.baseline: He didn’t want to kill them. He only wanted peace.
hunks.sol: He did not want to kill them. He only wanted peace.

hunks.baseline: He wasn’t a Killing Ghost, forever thirsting for blood. Every time one of the Hunters who had united under a single banner for the sake of the world fell, he felt pain and sorrow.
hunks.sol: He was no Killing Ghost, forever thirsting for blood. Whenever another Hunter who had united with the others under one banner for the sake of the world fell, he felt pain and sorrow.

hunks.baseline: In the end, this too was a struggle for each side’s own purpose.
hunks.sol: In the end, this too was a struggle for each side’s purpose.

hunks.baseline: To gain peace, they had to wage war. And in that war, rivers of blood and death would flow.
hunks.sol: To gain peace, they had to wage war. And war meant blood and death beyond counting.

hunks.baseline: “It’s too late to turn back now. For me, and for you.”
hunks.sol: “It’s too late to turn back now. For me and for you.”

hunks.baseline: The moment Jin Taekyung’s quiet voice rang out—
hunks.sol: As Jin Taekyung’s quiet voice rang out—

hunks.baseline: The air and wind that had stopped woke again.
hunks.sol: The still air and wind stirred again.

hunks.baseline: The old man, whose recovery was no longer human thanks to the help of magical power, got back to his feet under his own strength. Waiting for him was a spectacle of steel filling the air.
hunks.sol: At that same moment, the old man got back to his feet. Magical power had given him a recovery beyond anything human, but waiting for him was a mass of steel filling the air.

hunks.baseline: The old man couldn’t finish. And it wasn’t just him. No one could have.
hunks.sol: He could not finish. No one could have.

hunks.baseline: All they could do was stare, dumbfounded.
hunks.sol: All they could do was stare.

hunks.baseline: The wave of steel had left the side of its former master, who had met his death, and welcomed a new one. It rolled through the air.
hunks.sol: The wave of steel had left its dead former owners behind and taken a new master. It surged through the air, cold edges glinting as each weapon turned toward its target.

hunks.baseline: Its cold body glinted as it turned toward each of its targets.
And at the center of it all stood Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: At the center of it all stood Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: Facing a reality he couldn’t believe, the old man let out a sigh. A murky force—neither monster nor human—overflowed through the scimitar gripped in his hand.
hunks.sol: The old man sighed at the impossible sight. A murky force, neither monster nor human, overflowed from the scimitar in his hand.

hunks.baseline: With the prayer ringing in his heart, the old man stepped forward alone.
hunks.sol: With that prayer ringing in his heart, the old man stepped forward alone.

hunks.baseline: He left behind his followers, paralyzed with fear and waiting only for death. He went forward carrying the sense of duty and pride of a warrior chosen by God.
hunks.sol: He left behind his followers, paralyzed with fear and waiting for death. He went forward with the duty and pride of a warrior chosen by God.

hunks.baseline: *Is this— is this really what God wanted?*
hunks.sol: *Is this—is this really what God wanted?*

hunks.baseline: For the first time, the old man, who had believed in God and the Prophet more than anyone, felt doubt.
hunks.sol: For the first time, the old man who had believed in God and the Prophet more than anyone felt doubt.

hunks.baseline: But even now, as he charged like a streak of light and watched the rain of steel pour from the sky, brimming with lava-hot mana, he couldn’t find an answer.
hunks.sol: Even as he charged like a streak of light, even as he watched steel rain down from the sky filled with lava-hot mana, he could find no answer.

hunks.baseline: Just as it had never answered, from the distant past until now. And just as it would never answer in the future.
hunks.sol: It never had, from the distant past until now. And it seemed it never would.

hunks.baseline: Only a faint voice reached his ears—a voice that might belong to God or to a demon.
hunks.sol: Only a faint voice reached his ears. He could not tell whether it belonged to a god or a demon.

hunks.baseline: A gale swept through. A wave of steel, falling in place of damp rain, swallowed him.
hunks.sol: A gale swept through. A wave of steel fell in place of rain and swallowed him.

hunks.baseline: As his body and power—part monster, part human—were smashed to pieces, the old man heard a terrible scream ringing faintly in the distance.
hunks.sol: As his body and power—part monster, part human—were smashed to pieces, the old man heard a terrible scream echoing faintly.

hunks.baseline: His vision darkened. His consciousness scattered. And the warriors of God met their brutal end.
hunks.sol: His vision darkened. His consciousness scattered. The warriors of God met their brutal end.

hunks.baseline: He finally knew the answer to his question.
hunks.sol: At last, he knew the answer to his question.

hunks.baseline: But even though he found the answer in his final moment, the old man’s face was twisted with anger and disbelief.
hunks.sol: Though he had found the answer in his final moment, the old man’s face was twisted with anger and disbelief.

hunks.baseline: The weapons swinging at one another stopped in midair, and the shouts bursting from hoarse throats abruptly cut off.
hunks.sol: Weapons swinging at one another stopped in midair. Shouts forced from hoarse throats cut off.

hunks.baseline: Then everyone turned to look in the same direction.
hunks.sol: Every head turned in the same direction.

hunks.baseline: A scream of steel raining through the air. And a scream of terror from people who sensed their own deaths.
hunks.sol: The scream of steel raining through the air. The terrified screams of people who sensed their deaths.

hunks.baseline: Dust billowed upward. Through the sand surging like a whirlwind, streams of blood spurted like fountains.
hunks.sol: Dust billowed upward. Through sand surging like a whirlwind, streams of blood spurted like fountains.

hunks.baseline: The fanatics standing dozens of meters away stared blankly at the sight and blinked.
hunks.sol: Dozens of meters away, fanatics stared blankly at the sight and blinked.

hunks.baseline: Blood poured over their heads and ran down in sticky streams, along with something hard and something soft.
hunks.sol: Blood rained onto their heads and ran down in sticky streams, along with something hard and something soft.

hunks.baseline: It didn’t take them long to realize what those things were: human bone and flesh.
hunks.sol: It did not take long to realize what had fallen on them: human bone and flesh.

hunks.baseline: Their hands and feet trembled. The clatter of their teeth spread among the fanatics like an epidemic.
hunks.sol: Their hands and feet trembled. The clatter of teeth spread among the fanatics like an epidemic.

hunks.baseline: They already knew. The most carefully chosen elite troops had been waiting in the rear to join the fight with the commander-in-chief.
hunks.sol: They all knew that carefully chosen elite troops had been waiting in the far rear with the commander-in-chief, ready to join the fight.

hunks.baseline: But from this moment on, that fact belonged to the past.
hunks.sol: Now that was a fact of the past.

hunks.baseline: Everyone on the battlefield understood it by instinct.
hunks.sol: Everyone on the battlefield understood instinctively.

hunks.baseline: No one could survive in that steel storm raging now.
hunks.sol: No one could survive the storm of steel raging there.

hunks.baseline: No—if there was anyone who could, it was one person alone.
hunks.sol: No—there was one person who could.

hunks.baseline: As the name surfaced in everyone’s mind—
hunks.sol: As the name surfaced in every mind—
